WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT s.riskeval, 
         SUM(sm.facetfaces) as sum_faces,
         COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(sum_faces) as avg_sum FROM grouped
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT g.sum_faces, g.record_count, ac.avg_sum
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac
  WHERE ac.avg_sum IS NOT NULL AND g.sum_faces > ac.avg_sum
)
SELECT SUM(sum_faces) as total_of_sums,
       AVG(record_count) as average_of_record_counts,
       AVG(sum_faces - avg_sum) as average_of_differences
FROM filtered
